images.author: ron brinkmann
images.why: Classic Angel Falls view in early morning light, with the immense tepui wall and rainforest. Strong poster candidate; commercial use requires separate permission. File dimensions unverified.

images.author: Stefan Stefanov
images.why: Source identifies a people-free aerial photograph of Angel Falls dropping into green jungle. Dramatic alternative; supplied image is only 1400 × 1050.

images.author: Solomon Onyeagoro
images.why: Exact Zuma Rock with lush greenery and vivid blue sky. Confirmed 4480 × 6720 photograph; ample resolution for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Recognisable rounded monolith above a green field, with trees framing the foreground and blue sky. Landscape alternative from the local resort; dimensions and current file availability unverified.

images.author: Bernd 📷 Dittrich
images.why: Source explicitly identifies Deadvlei’s orange dune, cracked white clay pan and clear blue sky. Isolated dead tree provides a strong focal point for a 9:10 crop; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Andrew Svk
images.why: Location-confirmed Deadvlei photograph with a lone dead tree and desert setting, taken with a Nikon D800. Simple composition offers cropping flexibility; native dimensions and morning timing unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Classic aerial of northern Bazaruto Island: pale dunes and sandbanks against turquoise shallows and deep-blue ocean. Strong geographic match; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Azura Benguerra (credited image provider; photographer unnamed)
images.why: Helicopter panorama of Bazaruto Archipelago sandbars, dunes and bright turquoise channels. Broad natural landscape with strong colour; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Adam Rabinowitz
images.why: Documented aerial photograph of Bazaruto’s sculpted sandbanks and water patterns. Attractive abstract alternative for a near-square crop, though it lacks the classic high-dune vista; supplied preview is 1080 pixels wide.

images.author: Sohail Raza
images.why: Explicitly located at Saif ul Malook Lake near Naran, showing turquoise water and snowy mountains. Strong colour contrast; native dimensions and identification of the visible summit as Malika Parbat unverified.

images.author: Qasim Nagori
images.why: Source explicitly identifies Saiful Muluk in Kaghan Valley and mentions nearby Malika Parbat. Lake-and-mountain composition photographed with a Canon EOS 600D; native dimensions and visible summit identity unverified.
